messages.subject: Factor Scores for New Individuals
parts:
I have a CFA model that I fit to a large dataset using WLSMV. I would now like to use this model to estimate factor scores for new individuals. What would be the best way to do this? I could see several options:

1) Add the new individuals to the large dataset, re-estimate the model, and save factor scores for the new individuals.

2) Save the CFA model fit object and use it with lavPredict() and newdata to estimate the factor scores for the new individuals. However, a challenge here would be if not all levels of the ordinal variables are observed in the new data.

3) Refit the CFA model to the new individuals only and estimate the factor scores from that model. However, a challenge here would be if the new data is too small.
